text:
Alex K: Heads up — PR #24222 can't merge, several CI shards failing intermittently, holding the release train :train:
Sam T: Which shards? I can rerun targeted ones.
Alex K: shard-3 and shard-7 are timing out. CI bot posted errors.
CI Bot: Build failed for pr-24222 (shard-3)
CI Bot: ```
ERROR: Timeout waiting for process
tests/e2e/kv_shard_test.go:142: deadline exceeded
Command: ./scripts/run_shard.sh --shard 3
```
Maria P: I noticed similar timeouts last week — probably the new DB migration hit the test harness. Can we try a rerun with increased timeout or run only flakes?
Sam T: I'll do a targeted rerun for shard-3 and shard-7 now.
Sam T: /ci rerun --pr 24222 --shards 3,7 --env CI_TEST_TIMEOUT=90s
CI Bot: Rerun queued (targeted): pr-24222 shards=[3,7]
Jordan L: If both pass, we still need 1 more approver for the PR. Alex can you ping ops for the merge window? @DevOps Oncall
DevOps Oncall: Noted — we have a 30m merge window at 16:00 PT. If CI is green by then we can merge.
Alex K: Thanks — Sam, please post quick results. If rerun flakes again, we'll open a quick bisect thread.
Sam T: shard-3 passed, shard-7 failed with intermittent KV evict flakiness. logs:
Sam T: ```
ASSERT: expected len(cache) == 0
kv_cache_test.go:89
Repro: sometimes on high-concurrency
```
Maria P: Ok that points to race in eviction path. I can push a small test guard to the PR, want me to add it as a follow-up commit?
Alex K: Yes please, but keep it small. Once pushed Sam can rebase and trigger CI again.
Sam T: pushing a tiny fix now. /ci trigger pr-24222
CI Bot: Build started for pr-24222 (full matrix)
CI Bot: ETA ~12m
Jordan L: @Alex K also, please add a note in the PR description about the merge window and that devops approved.
Alex K: Done.
Sam T: All green! CI passed on full matrix. @Jordan L can you approve to clear the last reviewer slot?
Jordan L: LGTMed, merging now. :sparkles:
CI Bot: Merge completed for pr-24222
Alex K: Thanks team — keeping an eye on rollout telemetry.
Maria P: Nice, filing an issue for the eviction race so it doesn't slip.
